verdict.rationale: None of the first-party docs in the pack publish Gaudi 3 memory specifications. They cover software, PCIe form factor and Ethernet, but not capacity, memory type, bus width or bandwidth. The only memory details come from a community commenter citing HBM2e, 8 stacks and about 3.7TB/s, which is not vendor publication and still omits capacity and bus width.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, memory specs are published in full for this exact part — capacity, memory type, bus width, and bandwidth
